posts.title: sometimes i wanna just stop thinking
posts.content: actually, usually its not so bad, but its really hitting me right now. which is why im writing this actually. im hoping it'll get my mind off stuff a little.. sometimes i feel so overwhelmed. a day can go so well but you just have to think the wrong thoughts at the wrong time, they chain together and keep inviting more to come and its just really overwhelming. usually when I get into patterns like that I try to talk to friends, or I distract myself somehow. something that usually helps me a lot to vent my feelings in situations like that is music. but its so freaking frustrating when even music makes me feel worse because i compare it to my own and think about how bad i am and how much better i wish i was. that feeling really fucking hurts, to be honest. everything kinda hurts. i often put on such a tough front and pretend like everything's fine and great, but it isn't. i worry and struggle a lot and its a constant battle to keep my spirits up and stay happy and hopeful and stable. not that it isn't working, for the most part. it does and i would say i'm generally happy and things are good. but god it feels good to admit to myself for once that things aren't easy and that i'm struggling and feeling these things. i feel a bit relieved after having written that. i wonder if anyone ever reads these. not like id expect anyone to, but itd be nice to think these thoughts arent just thrown at a wall nobody cares about. i often wonder about what i should or shouldnt put on here, whats appropriate. honestly who cares lol. the vast majority of people wont read it anyway and i feel like the few people who would are close enough to me to where i shouldnt be embarassed or worried about anything. i got together with someone recently!! and ive been very happy about that. i'd be lying if i said it wasn't tough to adjust. letting myself rely on someone and get so invested in someone again is scary. and my brain constantly reminds me of all the things that could go wrong. all the worst case scenarios, all the tiny things i interpret into huge disastrous signs. luckily those feelings have been getting better, bit by bit. i often feel like i handle them pretty well. but when lots of things come together to overwhelm me, it can be quite tough. because it just adds to this chain of unproductive and hurtful and bad thoughts. but im happy. really happy. ive known them for so long and im really excited to finally get a shot at this. i have had this weird sort of embarassment about long distance relationships my whole life... like i think people will think its stupid or silly or whatnot when i tell them. i really wonder where that comes from. because that thought is stupid.. and doesnt feel nice. i wanna be proud of it because im so excited and happy. but my brain just jumps to conclusions, assuming the worst, which is totally silly and stupid. because like, even *if* that were true, that people thought it was silly... why would i care?? why would that matter? i guess this is that ancient problem of caring about what other people think. i guess the obvious answer is just that it isnt that easy and its normal to be worried and you can just try to be a bit better about it. or maybe you really can just stop giving a fuck and stop caring about what others think. or can you? i feel like some people do that, and i admire them. idk if maybe those people were just born to be like that, and im not, or whether i can get there too. am i insecure? ive asked myself that question for a long time. i used to say im somewhat confident in myself. i see some value in myself and know i have some sort of worth, and that gives me enough confidence to like, get through life and whatnot. but do i really truly deeply love myself and all parts of myself? idk. not really. i doubt myself too often for that. talk myself down and compare myself to others. and there we kinda go full circle i guess... maybe im just insecure. maybe i just need to be more confident in myself. who i am, and the things i make. maybe i should stop comparing myself to others or social norms. not maybe, i totally should. its obviously the right answer. but really, its hard. its really, really hard. i tried reading this book earlier this year to kinda help myself with that stuff.. i wonder if i should try again. but im doubtful i can just learn to love myself and be confident in myself by reading a book. or maybe i can. i suppose it wouldnt hurt to try. yeah, i think thats the right conclusion to come to. idk. i am super ultra rambling right now but it feels good. i feel a weight off my shoulders compared to when i started writing this. a heavy weight. a suffocating, drowning weight. and now i feel a bit lighter, just barely floating atop the water. which is a good place to be, i think. im okay with it, at least. thank you, visual studio code editor window, for being here and listening to me. and thanks to anyone who would actually ever read this, if anyone. if you do, i appreciate you. and pls dont think im weird or judge me or hate me and block me and tell everyone how stupid i am and jqwklejqweklnqlwne <3

posts.title: i have no clue what i want to write
posts.content: i have no clue what i want to write. but i want to write something. its been too long... well, how long has it been? 9 days. i guess a lot has happened in the last 9 days.. so maybe thats why it feels like a long time. sometimes i feel myself wanting to make things or write things that my brain immediately rejects because itd be too embarassing, or i feel like it's someone else's thing and i wouldnt do very well. i know thats a silly thought but its hard. i wonder if this stuff ever gets easier.. will i ever just make stuff i wanna make and share it, without any of those strings attached? or is this maybe the nature of making art thats close to you? the fact that its vulnerable and putting it out there is.. risky. i mean, what if someone thinks its stupid. what if they think less of me for it. cringe at it, cant stand through it. my brain immediately jumps to 'who cares about them that doesnt matter' but honestly, i dont think thats right. it does matter. i care about what people think of the stuff i make, and i want them to like it, to get something out of it, even if its just tiny. itd be a lie to say i only make stuff for myself. so i suppose thats just how it is.. itll always suck and be hard and you just have to try to learn to deal with it. to make it and share it anyway. i think i do an okay job at it, relatively speaking.. uploading that last ep really took a lot out of me. it was embarrassing as hell. i beat myself up over it for days, cringing at myself and being mad at myself for not just leaving it on my hard drive forever. but now that some time has passed, nothing happened. the world isnt over, my friends dont hate me. maybe somebody thought it was embarrassing and bad? but even if they did, i didnt hear or notice. and a few people were nice about it and said some nice things. which is kinda exactly what i wanted and was hoping for... but idk. its just hard. but i hope to learn. and get better. with time. i guess even just writing this right not and putting it on here is already a bit of an achievement.. i was scared of starting this whole thing too after all. but here i am only half embarrassed each time i write and upload a post. maybe it does get better....... who knows!! i dont.

posts.title: why do i want to travel
posts.content: before this year, i never traveled much. i was comfortable staying where i was and traveling seemed expensive and exhausting. earlier this year, traveling to the US and then japan within roughly 1.5 months, i got my first taste of what it was like. and since then, i find myself constantly thinking about where i could go next. i barely even think about spending my money on anything else, and i have lost all sensitivity to how expensive it all is, because it was so special. but i wonder why i feel this way. why am i so focused on getting away. why am i so desperate to relive that high, that sense of adventure. am i trying to get away from something? am i looking for something i dont have? what do i hope to gain from it all? maybe i am overthinking it. traveling is fun and cool and its only natural i would wanna do it again. but i do wonder what exactly i liked so much about it. i went to japan alone, and the thought of traveling with someone else in the future sounds nice. but finding someone to do that with also seems hard. i wonder if ive been thinking about all this stuff too much, blaming myself for having these feelings. like i should be happy with less, with what i have. but maybe thats not true, maybe its okay to long for things, work towards them and enjoy life that way. or maybe its a balance. its probably a balance... idk. either way, im sure eventually ill have an opportunity that feels fitting and worth it. and then ill go for it for sure!! until then, ill take it slow and just see what happens.

posts.title: idkkk
posts.content:
i wonder what i want from life. for most of my life i thought i lived for connecting with others, for the type of connection i was craving. recently ive felt other motivations. living just for the sake of living, of creating, of experiencing new things and enjoying the way life unfolds itself. but its conflicting. because sometimes the former shines through and it makes me doubt whether the latter really is enough. and life just cant always be exciting and eventful. sadly, it feel like the two options are almost incompatible. you cant have stability and commitment as well as spontaniety and novelty. or maybe you can. but i totally tend to just settle down and become complacent with the way things are and not changing anything.
maybe im just too afraid to commit, to make the same mistakes ive made in the past. there is something beautiful about both ways of living and i feel like it would be cool to commit to something if i felt confident about it. maybe theres no point in worrying about all this to begin with.. its just a choice id have to make whenever i actually have the choice. but until then its still weird to think about. wish life was just a little easier.. or maybe it is and im just making it hard for myself. this year has already been so eventful and its not even half way done, so i think ive done a decent job so far. and im sure ill make the best of whatever comes. but i wont settle on any particular way of thinking for now, and ill see where life takes me. i think thats the best approach.

posts.title: making stuff sucks
posts.content:
making art is hard. i know this feeling of opening up fl studio and only making complete unusable garbage all to well. following some weird idea without it going anywhere. and yet, it still always makes me feel as useless and incapable as it did when i started making music. it makes me feel like im incapable of making anything, like i finally lost it, like ill never be able to make something good again. and that feeling sucks so much. as always, i will come back another day when i feel more into it, and i will make something i am proud of again. but until that day my mind is tainted by this frustrating, sad experience that is so annoyingly irrational.
ive also felt such a strong urge to branch out into other genres and stuff. i wanna make the stuff ive been enjoying so much lately, but it sucks. its hard to try out new things. when i first started making music, everything i made was utter useless garbage that nobody would ever wanna listen to. and that felt bad enough to the point where i just stopped making music for years. im still not sure anybody would actually listen to any of the stuff i make, but at least i can find some value in it. but when trying out new things, its just as hard again. but i suppose its worth it. it was worth sticking around back then and its just a matter of trusting the process. maybe i need to do that again... or maybe part of the problem is doing this all alone. its kinda sad to think ive only ever done this stuff completely alone. i wouldnt even know how to involve anyone else in the process, but i think that would be nice. idk... its all weird. and complicated. all i know is that this feeling sucks. but i know that in a few days or weeks, i will start up fl studio again, and maybe that time will go better. and maybe one day ill finally genuinely make something that i can be proud of, something that i want to make. one day.

posts.title: change
posts.content: change is scary. even getting used to shitty situations is often more comfortable than confronting myself with any chance of things changing. but obviously that can't be good for you.. or maybe it is. im not sure. things are confusing!! but taking a step feels nice. not knowing whether its the right or wrong direction is weird, but at the very least you're going somewhere, not stuck in the same safe space. good things can only come from change and daring to leave that place of comfort. or maybe it's not about the good things at all. maybe its just about finally not standing still anymore. maybe change is what makes life good. who knows. im confused. i always will be!! but thats okay. i dont need to understand. but im not gonna stand still, ill take things into my own hands and deal with the consequences. because, at the very least, i know im trying and i know im alive. that has value in itself.

posts.title: website shenanigans
posts.content:
i guess this is my first post here lol.. hi!! whoever may read this. im making this whole addition to my website along with the music part because i got motivated by a person i will refer to with the codename toolf (whoever that may be), but ive been meaning to do this stuff for a while, especially the blog part. i worked on the music part for quite a few hours and then spit out this blog feature in like 30 mins... but it was fun! i havent really done any sort of coding in a while. even though i study computer science. how sad. its also worrying how little i actually did myself.. almost everything was just copying code. i understood almost all of it but like, i totally couldnt write it from scratch without taking 100x longer looking everything up. definitely giving me a bit of impostor syndrome, but.. whatever. im sure its fine!!
the features i worked on are far from perfect (didnt care to implement the mute button for the volume control), and the whole input prompt is causing some scrolling issues on mobile, but at least it works.. i think ill embrace that this website is more of a desktop experience and just try to make sure mobile at least works.
releasing thoughts like this is weird. who am i talking to? who am i thinking will read this? will any of the people who i think will read it actually read it? what would they think? is this a kind of diary? isnt the whole point of diaries that theyre private and you can write whatever in them? am i supposed to be fully honest and open here? where is the line?
idk. so many questions. but thats okay!! this is just a fun little place i can put random stuff on. and if its embarassing or dumb, ill delete it!! but hopefully not. thanks to whoever might have read this. please send me cute cat gifs. and have a good day pls!!
